figures.caption: Fig. 3. t-SNE visualization of representations learned with and without UO-IC. Blue: lesion-like background representations; red: small-lesion representations; yellow: remaining original-lesion representations. UO-IC improves alignment between small-lesion and other lesion representations while separating lesion-like background representations.
